Webamp 2.3.1 (https://github.com/captbaritone/webamp), MIT, by Jordan Eldredge.

`webamp.butterchurn-bundle.min.mjs` is `built/webamp.butterchurn-bundle.min.mjs`
from the npm package `webamp@2.3.1`, unmodified. It carries Butterchurn and a
preset pack for the MilkDrop window. It makes no network requests of its own.

An upgrade goes in a new version folder (/vendor is cached immutable).
